content: ग्लै €1 <ab>P.</ab> (ग्लायति, ग्लान) .²1 To feel aversion or dislike, be unwilling or disinclined to do anything (with <ab>inf.</ab>). .²2 To be fatigued or wearied, feel tired or exhausted. .²3 To despond, sink in spirit, be dejected; नाऽवकल्प्यमिदं ग्लायेद् यत् कृच्छ्रेषु भवानपि <ls>Bk. 19. 17</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">6. 12</ls>. .²4 To wane, fade, faint away. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (ग्ल-ग्लपयति, but प्रग्लापयति) .²1 To cause to fade away, wither up; ग्लपयति यथा शशाङ्कं न तथा हि कुमुद्वतीं दिवसः <ls>Ś. 3. 16</ls>; <ls>Ku. 3. 49</ls>. .²2 To tire out, exhaust. .²3 To injure, trouble, hurt. .²4 To emaciate, waste; व्रतैः स्वमङ्गं ग्लपयन्त्यहर्निशम् <ls>Ku. 5. 29</ls>; <ls>U. 3. 5</ls>.
